component.name: Capture to Search
component.summary: Search any part of your screen with Google Lens

description.p: Capture to Search lives in your system tray. Press Capture, drag out a region of the screen, and your browser opens on the Google Lens results for whatever you selected.
A small resident daemon owns the tray icon and the capture; the window is spawned on demand and closed again, so almost nothing stays in memory while the app waits in the tray.

ul.li: Region or full-screen capture, on both Wayland and X11
Works across desktops: the XDG screenshot portal first, then grim, spectacle, gnome-screenshot, and other tools as fallbacks
A command-line capture you can bind to a keyboard shortcut in your desktop settings
A doctor command that reports which capture backend was chosen and why every other one was rejected
